title: Cosmic Dragon Trinity
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring three green-skinned female faces merged together in the center, a large dark dragon with glowing yellow eyes coiled above them, and a silhouetted witch standing on a cracked reflective platform to the right. The left side shows a vibrant cosmic vortex with swirling stars, planets, and glowing particles against a green and purple nebula background.
